style: Simple old sea-map symbols: broad iron-gall contours, plain cream and tan areas, sparse interior marks, transparent PNG

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: one transparent PNG game sprite, a simple heavy freighter symbol drawn on an old sea map.
Art direction: spare folk-map ink drawing, a slightly uneven hand-carved stamp. Bold confident dark-brown outlines, large plain cream sail shapes and a flat muted tan hull. Friendly handmade imperfection in the contours, mature and understated. Extremely low detail. Every mark should still matter when reduced to 200 pixels wide.
Subject: a stout wooden merchant freighter in broadside profile facing RIGHT, high stern at LEFT, one closed deep cargo hull, exactly THREE masts firmly touching its deck, two plain square sails on each mast, a short bowsprit attached to the bow, one small faded red pennant. Keep the physical construction coherent, simple taut rigging with just a few diagonal ropes.
Detail budget: one curved fold line per sail; three long hull plank lines; four plain dark stern windows or ports; a few short grouped hatch strokes under the bow. No more small decoration. Clean open areas should comprise most of the illustration.
Palette: #1B1612 ink, #F4ECD8 cream, #D5C4A1 tan, tiny #8C2D19 pennant. Flat opaque colors inside the silhouette. No lighting effects or modeled volume.
Composition: square canvas, entire ship and all spar tips visible, about 80% canvas width and 72% height, 10% clear alpha margin on every side. A few simple curved wave marks below the keel. TRUE transparent background elsewhere.
Avoid: realistic rendering, engraved micro-lines, dense cross-hatching, stippling, grain, paper texture, watercolor, gradients, shadows, glossy materials, tiny crates, barrels, individual nails, complex rope ladders, ornamental galleries, elaborate fluttering cloth, scenery, typography, frame, labels, checkerboard background.
Aim for a simple marginal symbol in a weathered sailor's chart, with natural line character and a recognizable silhouette.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset: one transparent PNG Kraken sprite for a simple parchment sea-map game.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the new simple freighter. Match its bold slightly uneven dark-brown contours, broad cream/tan flat shapes, sparse interior marks and handmade folk-map character. Do not include the ship.
Subject: a large mythical octopus-like Kraken drawn as a marginal symbol on an old sailor's chart, turned slightly toward LEFT to confront a ship. One gently tilted pear-shaped mantle, eight distinct connected arms with varied graceful curls and plenty of open space between them. A natural asymmetrical pose. Small plain dark watchful eyes, no eyebrows, smile, teeth, horns, human expression, or cute mascot styling.
Simplicity: plain flat vellum body, thick iron-gall outline and a few muted tan patches on arm undersides. Use one or two long contour marks on the mantle, three or four widely spaced simple sucker ovals on ONLY two foreground arms, and three small groups of short parallel hatch marks. All remaining body surfaces must be quiet and plain. Curled arm tips should be distinctive and readable at 200px wide. Draw the creature with about the same visual complexity as the reference ship.
Palette: #1B1612 ink outlines, #F4ECD8 cream, #D5C4A1 tan only. Solid flat printed colors, restrained silhouette, natural slight line wobble and tapered strokes.
Composition: isolated entire creature centered on a square canvas, roughly 78% width and 76% height, at least 10% truly transparent margin around EVERY arm tip, no surrounding elements. A few simple curved waterline marks may sit immediately beneath it.
Avoid: anatomical realism, modeled volume, dense hatching, stippling, skin pores, realistic suction cups, repeated tiny dots, dense arm tangles, gradients, photographic shadows, glossy rendering, paper/grain texture, watercolor, cinematic effects, a decorative poster, text, frames, scenery, checkerboard. This is a spare functional sea-chart symbol with broad empty shapes, not a detailed engraving plate.

integration: Replaces the detailed pilot in Freighter selection/port/rest views and Flame combat, and Kraken combat. The v1 assets remain for comparison.
limitation: The Kraken remains a fixed illustration with live HUD tentacle count and severing feedback.
